\section*{Question 4}

Let \(h\) be a function defined for all \(x \neq 0\) such that \(h(4)=-3\) and the derivative of \(h\) is given by \(h^{\prime}(x)=\frac{x^{2}-2}{x}\) for all \(x \neq 0\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find all values of \(x\) for which the graph of \(h\) has a horizontal tangent, and determine whether \(h\) has a local maximum, a local minimum, or neither at each of these values. Justify your answers.
\item[(b)] On what intervals, if any, is the graph of \(h\) concave up? Justify your answer.
\item[(c)] Write an equation for the line tangent to the graph of \(h\) at \(x=4\).
\item[(d)] Does the line tangent to the graph of \(h\) at \(x=4\) lie above or below the graph of \(h\) for \(x>4\) ? Why?
\item[(a)] \(h^{\prime}(x)=0\) at \(x= \pm \sqrt{2}\)
